blessing.jaymoskingdoms.hearthkeeper.1.d: Out of a fight, your wounds close a little every few seconds.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.hearthkeeper.2.d: Your revives and treatments take a fifth less time.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.hearthkeeper.3.d: A villager you bring round gets up stronger: healing and a little toughness for a while.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.hearthkeeper.4.d: Heals everyone friendly around you and asks the downed to rise.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.anvil_father.1.d: What you hold wears more slowly.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.anvil_father.2.d: The anvil's perfect mark is wider for you.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.anvil_father.3.d: Now and then an ore you mine gives twice.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.anvil_father.4.d: For three minutes you dig fast, every ore gives twice and nothing you hold wears.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.1.de: Your breath lasts far longer under water.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.2.de: At sea, the storms' lightning keeps away from you.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.3.de: On the deep ocean, great whales come up near your boat more often.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.deep_mother.4.de: For five minutes you breathe water and swim like the sea's own.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.green_huntsman.1: Your steps are quieter: you are harder to see sneaking.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.green_huntsman.2: A carcass you dress on a meat hook gives more.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.green_huntsman.3: Beasts of legend are easier to find and to draw out.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.green_huntsman.4: For two minutes you run fast, strike beasts harder and make no sound.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.lantern_warden.2: The undead and vampires take more from your blows.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.lantern_warden.3: The Nightfall plague takes a weaker hold on you.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.lantern_warden.4: The undead and vampires around you burn.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.crowned_sun.1.de: Lords think well of you sooner, and guards stop you less.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.crowned_sun.3.de: A war party you call up musters more soldiers.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.crowned_sun.4.de: You and those who fight beside you grow strong and hard to hurt for two minutes.
The guards give up the hunt for you sooner.
You vanish in smoke, and for half a minute nobody bears witness to what you do.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.truth.1.desc: The cursed among townsfolk can't hide from your eyes.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.truth.2.desc: Townsfolk and clerics of the Truth charge you less and warm to you sooner.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.truth.3.desc: Spells bite you less, and guards and priests believe your word.
blessing.jaymoskingdoms.truth.4.desc: Every curse on you is lifted, and the cursed around you are shown for what they are.
